title: PRISM BREAK
oneLiner: Aim your returns, catch powerups and clear three prismatic brick formations.
mechanics: Clear three authored stages. Bricks require one, two or three accepted collisions.
Aim the return with paddle placement; a timed A pulse accelerates the ball.
Every sixth broken brick drops a wide-paddle, slow-ball or multiball pickup.
Three shared lives; lose a life only when the last active ball falls.
Two players cover independent left and right court halves and share the stage objective.

controls.a: Launch; press just before a return for a power pulse

lose: Exhaust the shared lives or reach the six-minute time limit.
scoring: 20 times original brick durability plus a consecutive-hit bonus; 50 per pickup; 250 per stage for each player.
note: Original catalogue foundation; no commercial game assets.
